content: {"episode_id":"ep-05010","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and unspecified atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring."}
